verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago documents a ready-to-use hosted checkout and a Checkout API, a Postman collection for testing requests, test users for validating payment flows, and AI tooling (a Claude Code plugin and a prompt library) that claims fast integrations. That points to a reasonably short path to a working payment flow from first-party docs. However, the pack shows no copy-paste code samples, language SDKs, or quickstart, and nothing independently corroborates an under-a-day integration. Missing for 10: copy-paste code examples in multiple languages, official language SDKs, a documented quickstart or time-to-first-payment evidence, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can integrate a working payment flow from the docs alone in under a day, with copy-paste examples in my language

citations.quote: Ready-to-use checkout. Redirect customers to a payment page hosted by Mercado Pago.
